steps.signoff: Each dedicated release happens only after successful full encoded decode, second-by-second artwork checks, scene audio correlation and five device routes. Run the public deployed routes again after main integration. The two standalone assets use their pre-existing same-origin filenames and await the checked staging commit, not a manual binary edit.

canonical_slot.bridge: Track the sleeve that crosses from the units drawer into the tens drawer. Later, read the hundreds drawer first.

revisits.bridge: When eight and eight make sixteen, follow the six loose units and the sleeve worth one ten. Where does each go before the tens are added?

chapters.title: Where did the zero come from?
The hundreds drawer can hold only one
The first tray that fills a hundred

canonical_slot.bridge: Follow the two digits when the ticket turns. At inspection, compare both the printed sum and the letters that received its digits.

revisits.bridge: In the ticket inspection, use the zero in the units column to force the missing digit. Then watch why 51 + 59 is rejected despite adding correctly.

chapters.title: Issue a ticket from two new clues

canonical_slot.bridge: Follow the three pairs into the ledger. When you subtract a pair from the total of all three boxes, which box stays behind?

revisits.bridge: Add the two stationery receipts. How many sets of one notebook and one ruler are in the combined purchase? Find the price of that set before finding either item separately.
In the three-box ledger, count how many times each box appears across the three pairs. Why can you halve the sum before subtracting the pair that omits one box?

canonical_slot.bridge: At the left edge, put a horizontal domino in the top row. Which cell now forces a second horizontal domino underneath?

revisits.bridge: Compare the board with two corners missing and the two-row domino strip. The area test rules out one tiling. Which boundary cell determines the next move on the other board?
When the first two horizontal dominoes form a block, cover that block with your hand. What smaller board remains, and how would fixing a middle piece divide it into two parts?
